description: Free. Everything a Watchdog has recorded for its endpoint since a given alert id: each change to status, payability, price or payTo, the endpoint’s state now, and next_since to pass on the next call. Use when: you created a watch with settled_watch and did not give a webhook. Not for: endpoints without a watch (use settled_check). Poll it whenever your agent runs; the endpoint is probed about every 15 minutes.

since.description: Return alerts with an id above this; pass next_since from your last call, or 0 for all

watch_id.description: The watch_id returned by settled_watch when the Watchdog was bought

name: settled_watch_alerts

alerts.description: Alerts since the given id, oldest first: each change to status, payability, price or payTo

attestation.description: EIP-191 signature over the answer; verify it with settled_verify or any EVM library

endpoint_now.description: The endpoint's state now: status, payability, price, payTo, last probe

error.description: Present only when the call failed or needs another step: an error code such as pass_required, next to the fields that explain it

expires_at.description: When the watch ends unless renewed

more.description: true when more alerts are waiting

next_since.description: Pass this as since on your next call

title: Read a Watchdog's alerts
